units.source_text: 柏木和我坐在铁丝网边的浪木上。

en.t: Kashiwagi and I sat on a piece of driftwood beside the wire fence.

units.source_text: 我偷偷地瞧了一眼这女子的容颜，不禁大吃一惊。

en.t: I stole a glance at the woman's face and could not help being greatly startled.

units.source_text: 因为她那张高雅的脸，与柏木向我说明的"喜欢X型的腿"的女人的相貌，是一模一样的。

en.t: For her refined face was exactly the same as the face of the woman Kashiwagi had described to me as liking X-shaped legs.

units.source_text: 可是后来，我觉得自己的这份惊愕未免太愚蠢了，因为柏木老早以前就熟悉这张脸，也许这是他的梦想。

en.t: But afterward I felt that my astonishment had been far too foolish, because Kashiwagi had known that face long before; perhaps it was his dream.
